messages:
julie: quick thread  we need to finalize burst refill cadence for Dedicated GA. Options on the table: weekly default (simpler billing) vs per-tenant daily option (customer-requested).
ken: runtime perspective: weekly is lowest ops cost. daily is doable but if we support both per-tenant we need more ledger sharding + nightly reconciliation.
ken: also decide "carryover" behavior. no-carryover = stateless at rollover. allow-carryover = stateful and more dispute surface.
maya: sales: two enterprise pilots asked for daily top-ups (one has strong diurnal traffic). they're ok paying an add-on. finance: weekly preferred for forecasting.
sam: eng-prod note: daily windows increase edge cases around rollovers at midnight UTC vs tenant's timezone. we should normalize to UTC for now to keep impl simple.
iris: cs: customers will expect easy explainability in console. recommend: show "current window remaining", "refill schedule", and a CSV export for ledger history.
liam: legal: if we label burst as "guaranteed" that changes contract. recommend we keep SLA language: "committed capacity = guaranteed; burst = best-effort". marketing can call daily a "faster refill" add-on.
julie: launch checklist (draft): 1) weekly refill implemented + telemetry 2) billing line-item + invoice export 3) console toggle (admin-only) for enabling daily per-tenant 4) CSV ledger export endpoint 5) docs + sample contract verbiage.
ken: ops risk: if we implement carryover we must handle negative balances and timezone cutover bugs. prefer no-carryover for GA; revisit carryover after 1st quarter.
maya: agreed. sales ask: allow paid pilot for daily (no carryover). they accept best-effort language.
sam: implementation estimate: weekly default (2 sprints), daily per-tenant feature flag + admin toggle (1 sprint extra), CSV export + billing changes (1 sprint). add QA/timezone testing (+1 sprint).
julie: rollout plan: staged - enable weekly GA -> ship billing & telemetry -> open beta for daily (feature-flagged) with 2 pilot tenants -> evaluate metrics (latency, disputes) -> decide on carryover.
iris: support playbook items: pre-made responses explaining best-effort burst, how to read CSV, and escalation path for billing mismatches.
liam: legal will draft the add-on clause: "daily refill (best-effort) - not a commitment to availability".
ops-bot: quota-monitor posted: "quota-ledger migration v2 completed in staging (build 215)" :white_check_mark:
julie: decision: GA = weekly refill, no carryover. daily refill available as paid, feature-flagged beta (UTC windows). Action owners: ken+sam = final estimate by Tue, iris = support doc snippets by Wed, liam = contract clause by Thu, maya = confirm pilots by Fri.
ken: noted. I'll include rollback steps for quota-ledger job in the estimate.
maya: pinged both pilots, AcmePay confirmed. Findr needs internal sign-off.
julie: thanks all  I'll push these into the roadmap and create the alpha ticket.
